shortDescription: Set network SNMP parameters in WTI OOB and PDU devices

options.name: authpass
options.description: Sets the Authentication Password for SNMPv3 (V3 only).

options.name: authpriv
options.description: Configures the Authentication and Privacy features for SNMPv3 communication, 0 = Auth/NoPriv, 1 = Auth/Priv (V3 only).

options.name: authproto
options.description: Which authentication protocol will be used, 0 = MD5, 1 = SHA1 (V3 only).

options.name: clear
options.description: Removes all the users for the protocol being defined before setting the newly defined entries.

options.name: contact
options.description: The name of the administrator responsible for SNMP issues.

options.name: cpm_password
options.description: This is the Password of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: cpm_url
options.description: This is the URL of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: cpm_username
options.description: This is the Username of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: enable
options.description: The activates SNMP polling for the specified interface and protocol.

options.name: index
options.description: Index of the user being modified (V3 only).

options.name: interface
options.description: The ethernet port for the SNMP we are defining.

options.name: location
options.description: The location of the SNMP Server.

options.name: privpass
options.description: Sets the Privacy Password for SNMPv3 (V3 only) (V3 only).

options.name: privproto
options.description: Which privacy protocol will be used, 0 = DES, 1 = AES128 (V3 only).

options.name: protocol
options.description: The protocol that the SNMP entry should be applied. 0 = ipv4, 1 = ipv6.

options.name: readonly
options.description: Controls the ability to change configuration parameters with SNMP.

options.name: rocommunity
options.description: Read Only Community Password, not used for SNMP V3.

options.name: rwcommunity
options.description: Read/Write Community Password, not used for SNMP V3.

options.name: systemname
options.description: The hostname of the WTI Device.

options.name: use_https
options.description: Designates to use an https connection or http connection.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: Flag to control if the lookup will observe HTTP proxy environment variables when present.

options.name: username
options.description: Sets the User Name for SNMPv3 access (V3 only).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If false, SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: version
options.description: Defined which version of SNMP the device will respond to 0 = V1/V2 Only, 1 = V3 Only, 2 = V1/V2/V3.
